subject: BrightBeam deployment mix & pricing summary
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Harper Chen <harper@brightbeam.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightbeam.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-17T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: BrightBeam deployment mix & pricing summary

Hi Harper / Liam —

Thanks again for the call earlier — useful to hear your product telemetry and the privacy constraints. Quick written recap and three deployment pathways with back-of-envelope economics so we have a shared baseline. Please confirm the traffic assumptions below and I’ll send a short pilot quote after you confirm which path you want us to scope.

Call takeaways (please flag any corrections):
- Primary workload: customer-facing chat + occasional batch embeddings for search.
- Typical prompt length (input): ~120 tokens; typical generated tokens: ~260 tokens per request.
- Expected steady-state: ~6k requests/day (avg); peak concurrency ~45 RPS burst; monthly tokens ~5M generated tokens.
- Data residency: US-only; PII in payloads — SOC 2 and VPC preferred.

Deployment options (high level, rough economics):

1) Hosted API (fastest path)
- Unit model: per-token billing. Example estimates (Redwood hosted): $0.0008 per generated token (model X), $0.0002 per input token.
- Math (monthly): 5M × 260 tokens × $0.0008 ≈ $1,040/month for generation (this assumes only generated tokens billed at the higher rate; input token cost adds ~ $52/month).
- Pros: zero infra ops, immediate onboarding, built-in failover.
- Cons: higher unit cost at scale, less control for strict VPC requirements.

2) Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) — recommended if steady high utilization
- Example: 8-GPU reserved pool (A100-equivalent), $60k/month list. With utilization at ~60–70% for your profile, modeled token unit cost ≈ $0.00015–$0.00025 per generated token.
- Math (monthly, illustrative): $60,000 / (5M × 260 tokens) ≈ $0.000046 per token raw — but real-world overhead (ops, multiplexing, lower model concurrency) brings this to the range above.
- Pros: predictable latency, lower unit cost at scale, stronger isolation.
- Cons: commit needed (monthly/annual), requires integration window for KV cache warm-up and rollout.

3) Private (VPC / on-prem)
- Typical structure: one-time setup & integration (~$40k), monthly platform fee + ops ~$35k/month, plus optional dedicated infra.
- Effective per-token depends strongly on your infra choices; at moderate scale can be similar to Dedicated but with additional setup lead time.
- Pros: max control, best for strict compliance (air-gapped/on-prem).

Break-even guidance (very rough):
- Under ~2–3M generated tokens/month: Hosted API likely simplest and cost-competitive.
- Above ~5M generated tokens/month with steady utilization: Dedicated reserved capacity usually becomes more economical if you can commit 3–12 months.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm monthly generated-token estimate (5M used above) and peak concurrency tolerance.
2) Confirm whether SOC 2 / VPC is a hard requirement for pilot.
3) Which path should we quote first? Our typical pattern: pilot on Hosted (2–4 weeks), then migrate to Dedicated reserved if economics justify.

I’ve attached a quick TCO workbook (BrightBeam-Rough-TCO.xlsx) and a short option pricing PDF. I’ll follow up internally to pull potential discount thresholds if you plan to commit for a quarter.

Thanks —

Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-05-17T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightBeam deployment mix & pricing summary

Tessa —

Thanks for the clear summary, that maps to what we discussed. A few clarifications and requests:

1) Token math: our current telemetry shows 4.6M generated tokens/month on average and a monthly high of 7.8M. For planning use 5M steady / 8M peak.
2) SOC 2 is in-scope; VPC is strongly preferred for the pilot (we can accept an encrypted transit tunnel + isolated tenant if full VPC is not immediately available).
3) Procurement asks: can you provide a simple three-scenario line item (Hosted monthly, Dedicated 3-month reserved, Dedicated 12-month reserved) with committed spend and unit cost after any standard growth discounts? Procurement would like the one-page that they can run internally.

Also: what SLAs are available on Dedicated vs Hosted? Our uptime requirement is >=99.9% for production.

If you can get a one-pager by EOD tomorrow we’ll route to procurement.

—Harper
Head of Platform — BrightBeam AI
harper@brightbeam.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: BrightBeam deployment mix & pricing summary (internal)

Internal note before we send the procurement one-pager:
- Recommended public offer for this ARR band: 10% off list for 3-month reserved, 18% off for 12-month reserved; we can push to 22% with a platform add-on commit (observability retention).
- For Hosted, provide two model tiers (standard vs high-throughput) and call out burst protection (soft limit + autoscale). Hosted per-token we typically show the listed rate and then a committed volume rebate for >8M tokens/month.
- SLA: Hosted: 99.5% (but multi-region fallback available); Dedicated (reserved) with enterprise SLO and runbook: 99.9% with a paid SLA add-on.

Proposed deliverables to procurement:
1) One-page line-item PDF (Hosted monthly estimate / Dedicated 3m reserved / Dedicated 12m reserved) with monthly unit economics and total committed spend.
2) Short appendix: SOC 2 attestation + VPC integration checklist.

I’ll draft the numbers and Monica — can you validate the A100-equivalent monthly list price we should show?

-Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Harper / Liam / Procurement —

Appended one-pager (attached: redwood-option-pricing.pdf) with the three scenarios you asked for. Highlights:
- Hosted (monthly): Estimated $1,120–$1,200/month at 5M generated tokens (includes input token line), scalable with committed volume rebates kicking in above 8M/month.
- Dedicated (3-month reserved): List $60k/month, discounted 10% => $54k/month; effective unit estimate at your 5M token baseline ≈ $0.00020/token. Includes 4-hour incident response SLA in the runbook.
- Dedicated (12-month reserved): List $60k/month, discounted 18% => $49.2k/month; effective unit ≈ $0.00017/token; includes 99.9% SLA option as an add-on.

We've included a short VPC integration checklist and SOC 2 reference in the appendix. Next practical step:
- If you want VPC for pilot: we need a 2-week integration window and a short network workshop (no cost).
- If you want to move fast without VPC: we can do a hosted pilot tomorrow and issue a pilot credit that mirrors the Dedicated economics for comparisons.

Would you like the procurement one-pager in DOCX for redlining or PDF? If DOCX, I’ll push the editable version to the Drive link and tag procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Tessa Morgan
